meta.title: Work Guard
meta.description: Turn "I fixed it" into evidence: gates that deny, verification with real exit codes, red→green tracking, and a change ledger.
meta.detail: Injects nine working habits into the system prompt; denies writes to source files that were not read; requires a real exit code before a verification counts; keeps a fix honest by tracking the tests that were red; one button in the composer for pending items and one status line under it.
